name: Bearing
description: Points the host layer's own markers in a direction taken from a feature property (clockwise from north). It decorates its host instead of drawing a sublayer, so it never appears in the layer's Composite Layers list.

components.name: Enabled
components.description: Sets a bearing direction (clockwise from north) of this layer's point markers (or Shape from Icon or Marker Icons if set). Overrides the layer's shape dropdown value.

components.name: Angle Property
components.description: The dot.notated path to the feature properties that contains the desired rotation angle. Ex. headings.yaw.

components.name: Color
components.description: A color for the directional arrow for non-Shape-from-Icon and non-Marker-Icon bearings.

components.name: Use Custom Marker Shapes
components.description: If true, the bearing marker's style does not default to being a directional-circle. This reenables setting the 'Shape' dropdown in the Style Tab instead of forcing it to be 'DIRECTIONAL-CIRCLE'.
